name: Bench Dip
steps: Sit on the edge of a sturdy flat bench with your palms gripping the front edge beside your hips and your feet planted ahead.
Slide your hips just clear of the bench, pack your shoulders down, and brace your core.
Bend your elbows straight behind you to lower your hips smoothly until your upper arms approach parallel to the floor.
Press firmly through your palms to extend your arms back to the top without shrugging.
tips: Keep your back close to the bench edge and limit depth before your shoulders roll forward.
Bend your knees closer for less resistance or straighten your legs farther out to increase challenge.
